history.content: hi. i dont really know why im here. just had a rough appointment today and i guess i needed somewhere to put it
Hey, that rough appointment sounds like it left something heavy sitting with you. You can put it here if you want, or just let it be for now.

heavy yeah. its my rheumatologist. ive been seeing her for almost three years now for my RA and ive trusted her with everything. and today she basically told me she doesnt think the pain im describing is real. like she actually said maybe its more anxiety than the disease
That sounds crushing, especially from someone you’ve trusted for so long. It can be its own kind of blow when pain you’ve lived with gets treated like it might not be real.

thats exactly it. its real. like i KNOW my body, ive been living in it for 34 years. and ive done everything right, i take the meds, i do the stretches, i track my flares in this stupid app she told me to use, and i sat there and i could feel my eyes getting hot and i didnt even say anything back i just nodded like an idiot. i think thats the part that gets me. that i let her say it and i just nodded
It sounds like the nod hurt almost as much as what she said. I’m wondering if that’s more hurt, or something closer to shame?

ugh i dont know. maybe both? the shame is like why didnt i stand up for myself. but underneath that i think im just. hurt? like she was supposed to be on my team. shes the one person in this whole medical mess who i thought actually saw me and now it feels like even she thinks im exaggerating or making it up for attention or whatever. it feels like being let down by the one person who wasnt supposed to let me down
That makes sense, both can be there at once. The hurt sounds tied to being let down by the one person you thought was on your side.

yeah. and the worst part is theres this little voice now going what if shes right. what if ive been making a bigger deal of it. and i hate that voice because thats exactly how it started when i was younger, doctors telling me it was in my head for YEARS before i finally got diagnosed. i fought so hard to be believed and i thought i was past that. and now its like one sentence from her and im right back there at 22 crying in a waiting room being told im fine when im not fine
That sentence pulled you right back into that waiting room at 22, after all the years you fought to be believed. If you want, we can stay with that, or leave it here for now.

no i think i need to stay with it for a sec. because i havent said this out loud to anyone. my partner keeps saying just find a new doctor like its that easy, like its a haircut. but its not just losing a doctor. its that i let her in. i told her things i dont tell people, about how scared i get that this is going to take my hands one day, that i wont be able to hold my niece. and she knows all that and she STILL looked at me today like i was being dramatic
She had all of that, the fear about your hands and your niece, and still looked at you like you were being dramatic. That sounds painfully exposing.

exposing is the right word. i feel kind of stupid for how much it stung honestly. shes just a doctor at the end of the day. but i think i wanted her to be more than that and thats on me maybe. i dont even know what i want to do about it. part of me wants to write her this long email and part of me wants to just never go back and ghost her like she ghosted the actual person sitting in front of her

That sounds like exposed hurt, and maybe a bit of anger too, with the email and the urge to disappear. I’m learning that this is about wanting her to meet the real person in front of her, not just the chart.

yeah theres definitely some anger in there too now that you say it. i didnt want to admit that because it feels easier to just be sad. anger means i have to do something with it. but youre right, i wanted her to meet the real person not the chart. thats it exactly. i dont have to decide tonight what to do though right. i think i just needed to not be the only one who knew this happened
No, you do not have to decide tonight. And you are not the only one who knows it happened now.
thank you. genuinely. i feel a little less like im carrying it alone. im gonna try to sleep and figure out the rest later. ok. goodnight
Goodnight, and may sleep be kind to you.
